My best frund,

I've never been great at saying the big things out loud, so I built you a small corner of the internet instead. Consider this my long way of saying happy birthday.

With you I don't have to edit myself. I can be too loud, too quiet, too ridiculous, too much — and you just make room for it, every time. That's rarer than people give it credit for. Most places ask you to be a slightly better-behaved version of yourself. You've only ever asked me to be the real one.

I also don't say this enough: I see the effort. The small things you didn't have to do but did anyway, the patience on days I didn't quite deserve it, the way you keep choosing this even when it would be easier not to. None of it goes unnoticed. All of it is why being around you feels like exhaling.

So today, of all days, I hope it's your turn to be looked after. Happy birthday, Aahana. Here's to another year of us being ridiculous together.
